a: Kodem shennivra haolam, velo nivreu. amad hakkadosh baruch hu ushetalan bechol dor vador, vehen hen azze fanim shebbaddor.

Verav nachman bar yitzchak amar: "asher kummetu" — livracha hu dichtiv. ellu talmide chachamim shemmekammetin atzman al divre tora baolam hazze, hakkadosh baruch hu megalle lahem sod laolam habba, shenneemar: "nahar yutzak yesodam".

Amar leh shemuel lechiyyay bar rav: bar arya! ta ema lach milleta mehane mille mealleyayta dahava amar avuch: kol yoma veyoma nivrain malache hashsharet minnehar dinur, veamri shira uvatli, shenneemar: "chadashim labbekarim rabba emunatecha". ufeliga derabbi shemuel bar nachmani. deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol dibbur vedibbur sheyyotze mippi hakkadosh baruch hu nivra mimmennu malach echad, shenneemar: "bidvar Adonai shamayim naasu uveruach piv kol tzevaam".

Katuv echad omer: "levusheh kitlag chivvar usear resheh kaamar neke". uchetiv: "kevutztzotav taltallim shechorot kaorev"! la kashya: kan bishiva, kan bammilchama. deamar mar: en lecha nae bishiva ella zaken, veen lecha nae bammilchama ella bachur.

Katuv echad omer: "korseye shevivin dinur", vechatuv echad omer: "ad di chorsavan remiv veattik yomin yetiv"! la kashya: echad lo veechad ledavid. kidtanya: echad lo veechad ledavid, divre rabbi akiva. amar lo rabbi yose haggelili: akiva, ad matay atta ose shechina chol?! ella: echad ledin veechad litzdaka.

Kaybla minneh, o la kaybla minneh? ta shema: echad ledin veechad litzdaka, divre rabbi akiva. amar lo rabbi elazar ben azarya: akiva, ma lecha etzel haggada! kelach middabberotecha etzel negaim veohalot. ella: echad lechisse veechad lishrafraf. kisse — leshev alav, sherafraf — lahadom raglav, shenneemar: "hashshamayim kisi vehaaretz hadom raglay".
Ki ata rav dimi, amar: shemone esre kelalot killel yeshaya et yisrael, velo nitkarra dato ad sheamar lahem hammikra hazze: "yirhavu hannaar bazzaken vehannikle bannichbad".

Shemone esre kelalot, may ninhu? dichtiv: "ki hinne haadon Adonai tzevaot mesir mirushalam umihuda mashen umashena kol mishan lechem vechol mishan mayim gibbor veish milchama shofet venavi vekosem vezaken. sar chamishshim unesu fanim veyoetz vachacham charashim unevon lachash. venatatti nearim sarehem vetaalulim yimshelu vam vegomer".

"Mashen" — ellu baale mikra. "mashena" — ellu bale mishna, kegon rabbi yehuda ben tema vachaverav. peligi ba rav pappa verabbanan, chad amar: shesh meot sidre mishna, vechad amar: sheva meot sidre mishna.

"Kol mishan lechem" — ellu baale talmud, shenneemar: "lechu lachamu velachami ushetu beyayin masachti". "vechol mishan mayim" — ellu baale aggada, shemmoshchin libbo shel adam kammayim beaggada. "gibbor" — ze baal shemuot. "veish milchama" — ze sheyyodea lissa velitten bemilchamtah shel tora. "shofet" — ze dayyayn sheddan din emet laamitto. "navi" — kemashmao. "kosem" — ze melech, shenneemar: "kesem al sifte melech". "zaken" — ze sherauy lishiva.

"Sar chamishshim" — al tikre "sar chamishshim", ella "sar chummashin". ze sheyyodea lissa velitten bachamishsha chumeshe tora. davar acher: "sar chamishshim" — kidrabbi avahu. deamar rabbi avahu: mikkan sheen maamidin meturegman al hatztzibbur pachot mechamishshim shana. "unesu panim" — ze shennosin panim ledoro baavuro. lemala, kegon rabbi chanina ben dosa. lematta, kegon rabbi avahu be kesar.

"Yoetz" — sheyyodea leabber shanim velikboa chodashim. "vechacham" — ze talmid hammachkim et rabbotav. "charashim" — beshaa sheppoteach bedivre tora hakkol naasin kechershin. "venavon" — ze hammevin davar mittoch davar. "lachash" — ze sherauy limsor lo divre tora shennittena belachash.
"Venatatti nearim sarehem". may "venatatti nearim sarehem"? amar rabbi elazar: ellu bene adam shemmenoarin min hammitzvot.

"Vetaalulim yimshelu bam" — amar rav pappa bar yaakov: taale bene taale. velo nitkarra dato, ad sheamar lahem: "yirhavu hannaar bazzaken vehannikle bannichbad" — ellu bene adam shemmenoarin min hammitzvot, yirhavu beme shemmemulla bemitzvot kerimmon. "vehannikle bannichbad" — yavo mi shechamurot domot alav kekallot, veyirhavu bemi shekkallot domot alav kachamurot.

Amar rav kattina: afillu bishat kishlonah shel yerushalayim — lo pasku mehem baale amana, shenneemar: "ki yitpos ish beachiv bet aviv simla lecha katzin tihye lanu". devarim shebbene adam mitkassin kesimla, yeshnan tachat yadecha.

"Vehammachshela hazzot". may "vehammachshela hazzot" — devarim sheen bene adam omdin alehen ella im ken nichshal bahen — "yeshnan tachat yadecha". "yissa vayyom hahu lemor lo ehye chovesh uveveti en lechem veen simla lo tesimuni ketzin am". "yissa" — en yissa ella leshon shevua, shenneemar: "lo tissa et shem Adonai elohecha". "lo ehye chovesh" — lo hayiti mechovshe bet hammidrash. "uveveti en lechem veen simla" — sheen beyadi lo mikra velo mishna velo gemara.
Vedilma shane hatam, dei amar lehu gemirna — amri leh: ema lan! hava leh lememar gemar ushechach. may "lo ehye chovesh" — lo ehye chovesh kelal.

Ini?! vehaamar rava: lo charva yerushalayim ad sheppasku mimmenna baale amana, shenneemar: "shottu bechutzot yerushalam ureu na udeu uvakshu virchovoteha im timtzeu ish im yesh ose mishpat mevakkesh emuna veeslach lah"! la kashya:
b: Ha bedivre tora, ha bemassa umattan. bedivre tora — havo, bemassa umattan — la havo.

Tanu rabbanan: maase berabban yochanan ben zakkay shehaya rochev al hachamor, vehaya mehallech badderech, verabbi elazar ben arach mechammer acharav. amar lo: rabbi, shene li perek echad bemaase merkava. amar lo, lo kach shaniti lachem: velo bammerkava beyachid ella im ken haya chacham mevin middato? amar lo: rabbi, tarsheni lomar lefanecha davar echad shellimmadtani. amar lo: emor.

Miyyad yarad rabban yochanan ben zakkay meal hachamor, venitattef, veyashav al haeven tachat hazzayit. amar lo: rabbi, mippene ma yaradta meal hachamor? amar: efshar atta doresh bemaase merkava, ushechina immanu, umalache hashsharet melavvin otanu, vaani erkav al hachamor?! miyyad patach rabbi elazar ben arach bemaase hammerkava vedarash. veyarda esh min hashshamayim, vesibbeva kol hailanot shebbassade, patchu kullan veamru shira.

Ma shira amru — "halelu et Adonai min haaretz tanninim vechol tehomot ... etz peri vechol arazim ... haleluyah". naana malach min haesh, veamar: hen hen maase hammerkava. amad rabban yochanan ben zakkay uneshako al rosho, veamar: baruch Adonai elohe yisrael shennatan ben leavraham avinu sheyyodea lehavin velachkor velidrosh bemaase merkava. yesh nae doresh veen nae mekayyem, nae mekayyem veen nae doresh. atta nae doresh venae mekayyem. ashrecha avraham avinu, sheelazar ben arach yatza mechalatzecha.

Ucheshenneemru haddevarim lifne rabbi yehoshua, haya hu verabbi yose hakkohen mehallechim badderech. amru: af anu nidrosh bemaase merkava. patach rabbi yehoshua vedarash. veoto hayyom tekufat tammuz haya. nitkashsheru shamayim beavim venire kemin keshet beanan, vehayu malache hashsharet mitkabbetzin uvain lishmoa, kivne adam shemmitkabbetzin uvain lirot bemazmute chatan vechalla.

Halach rabbi yose hakkohen vesipper devarim lifne rabban yochanan ben zakkay, veamar: ashrechem veashre yoladtechem, ashre enay shekkach rau. veaf ani veattem, bachalomi mesubbin hayeynu al har sinay, venittena alenu bat kol min hashshamayim: alu lechan, alu lechan! teraklin gedolim umatztzaot naot mutztzaot lachem, attem, vetalmidechem, vetalmide talmidechem mezummanin lechat shelishit.

Ini?! vehatanya, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: shelosha haretzaot hen, rabbi yehoshua hirtza devarim lifne rabban yochanan ben zakkay, rabbi akiva hirtza lifne rabbi yehoshua, chananya ben chachinay hirtza lifne rabbi akiva. veillu rabbi elazar ben arach la ka chashev! deartzi veartzo kammeh — kachashev, deartzi vela artzo kammeh — la ka chashev. veha chananya ben chachinay dela artzo kammeh, veka chashev! deartzi miha kammeh man deartzi.

Tanu rabbanan: arbaa nichnesu bappardes, veellu hen: ben azzay, uven zoma, acher, verabbi akiva. amar lahem rabbi akiva: kesheattem maggiin etzel avne shayish tahor, al tomru "mayim mayim", mishshum shenneemar: "dover shekarim lo yikkon leneged enay".

Ben azzay hetzitz vamet, alav hakkatuv omer: "yakar beene Adonai hammavta lachasidav". ben zoma hetzitz venifga, vealav hakkatuv omer: "devash matzata echol dayyekka pen tisbaennu vahaketo". acher kitztzetz bintiot. rabbi akiva yatza beshalom.

Shaalu et ben zoma: mahu lesarose kalba? amar lahem: "uveartzechem lo taasu", kol shebbeartzechem lo taasu. shaalu et ben zoma: betula sheibbera, mahu lechohen gadol? mi chayyshinan ledishmuel, deamar shemuel:

a: Yachol ani livol kamma beilot belo dam. o dilma dishmuel la shechicha? amar lehu: dishmuel la shechiach, vechayyshinan shemma beambati ibbera.
Vehaamar shemuel: kol shichvat zera sheeno yore kechetz — enah mazraat! meikkara name yore kechetz hava.

Tanu rabbanan: maase berabbi yehoshua ben chananya shehaya omed al gav maala behar habbayit, veraahu ben zoma velo amad millefanav. amar lo: meayin uleayin ben zoma? amar lo: tzofe hayiti ben mayim haelyonim lemayim hattachtonim, veen ben ze laze ella shalosh etzbaot bilvad, shenneemar: "veruach elohim merachefet al pene hammayim" — keyona shemmerachefet al baneha veenah nogaat. amar lahen rabbi yehoshua letalmidav: adayin ben zoma mibbachutz.

Mikkede "veruach elohim merachefet al pene hammayim" emat have — bayyom harishon, havedala — beyom sheni hu dahavay, dichtiv: "vihi mavdil ben mayim lamayim". vechamma? amar rav acha bar yaakov: kimlo nima. verabbanan amri: ki gudda degamla. mar zutera, veittema rav assi amar: kitre gelime difrisi ahadade. veamri la: kitre chase dischifi ahadade.

Acher kitztzetz bintiot, alav hakkatuv omer: "al titten et picha lachati et besarecha". may hi? chaza metatron deityehiva leh reshuta lemetav lemichtav zachvota deyisrael, amar: gemiri dilmala la have lo yeshiva velo tacharut, velo oref velo ippuy. shemma, chas veshalom, shete reshuyot hen.

Appeku lemetatron vmachyu shittin pulese denura. amaru leh: may tama ki chaziteh la kamt mikkammeh? ityehiva leh reshuta lemimchak zachvota deacher. yatzta bat kol veamra: "shuvu banim shovavim" — chutz meacher.

Amar: hoil veitterid hahu gavra mehahu alma, lippok lithane behay alma. nefak acher letarbut raa. nefak, ashkach zona tava, amara leh: velav elisha ben avuya at? akar pugela mimmeshra beshabbat vihav la, amra: acher hu.

Shaal acher et rabbi meir leachar sheyyatza letarbut raa, amar leh: may dichtiv: "gam et ze leummat ze asa haelohim"? amar lo: kol ma shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu, bara kenegdo. bara harim — bara gevaot, bara yammim — bara neharot.

Amar lo: rabbi akiva rabbecha lo amar kach, ella: bara tzaddikim bara reshaim, bara gan eden bara gehinnam. kol echad veechad yesh lo shene chalakim, echad began eden veechad begehinnam. zacha tzaddik — natal chelko vechelek chavero began eden, nitchayyev rasha — natal chelko vechelek chavero begehinnam.
Amar rav mesharsheya: may keraa — gabbe tzaddikim ketiv: "lachen beartzam mishne yirashu", gabbe reshaim ketiv: "umishne shibbaron shovrem".

Shaal acher et rabbi meir leachar sheyyatza letarbut raa, may dichtiv: "lo yaarchenna zahav uzechochit utemuratah keli faz"? amar lo: ellu divre tora, shekkashin liknotan kichle zahav uchele faz, venochin leabbedan kichle zechuchit. amar lo: rabbi akiva rabbach lo amar kach, ella: ma kele zahav uchele zechuchit, af al pi shennishberu — yesh lahem takkana, af talmid chacham, af al pi shessarach — yesh lo takkana. amar lo: af atta chazor bach! amar lo: kevar shamati meachore happargod: "shuvu banim shovavim" — chutz meacher.

Tanu rabbanan: maase beacher shehaya rochev al hassus beshabbat, vehaya rabbi meir mehallech acharav lilmod tora mippiv, amar lo: meir, chazor leacharecha, shekkevar shiarti beikve susi ad kan techum shabbat. amar lo: af atta chazor bach. amar lo: velo kevar amarti lecha kevar shamati meachore happargod: "shuvu banim shovavim" — chutz meacher.

Takfeh ayyeyleh leve midresha, amar leh leyanoka: pesok li pesukach. amar lo: "en shalom amar Adonai larshaim". ayyeyleh leve chenishta achariti, amar leh leyanoka: pesok li pesukach. amar lo: "ki im techabbesi banneter vetarbi lach borit nichtam avonech lefanay". ayyeyleh leve kenishta achariti, amar leh
b: Leyanoka: pesok li pesukach. amar leh: "veat shadud ma taasi ki tilbeshi shani ki tadi adi zahav ki tikrei vappuch enayich lashshav tityappi vegomer".

Ayyeyleh leve chenishta achariti, ad deayyeyleh litlesar be chenishata, kullehu pesaku leh ki hay gavvna. levatra amar leh: pesok li pesukach. amar leh: "velarasha amar elohim ma lecha lesapper chukkay vegomer". hahu yanoka hava megamgem belishshaneh, ishtema kema daamar leh: "veleelisha amar elohim", ikka deamri: sakkina hava bahadeh, vekareh veshaddareh litlesar be chenishate. veikka deamri, amar: i havay bidi sakkina, hava karana leh.

Ki nach nafsheh deacher, amri: la medan lidayyeyneh, vela lealma deate lete. la medan lidayyeyneh — mishshum daasak beorayyta, vela lealma deate lete — mishshum dachata. amar rabbi meir: mutav delidayyeyneh velete lealma deate. matay amut, veaale ashan mikkivro. ki nach nafsheh derabbi meir selek kutera mikkivreh deacher.

Amar rabbi yochanan: gevureta lemikle rabbeh? chad hava benana vela matzenan leatztzoleh? inketeh beyad, man marme leh min. amar: matay amut, vaachabbe ashan mikkivro. ki nach nafsheh derabbi yochanan pesak kutera mikkivreh deacher. petach aleh hahu safdana: afillu shomer happetach lo amad lefanecha, rabbenu!

Bitto shel acher atya lekammeh derabbi, amara leh: rabbi, parneseni. amar lah: bat mi at? amra lo: bitto shel acher ani. amar lah: adayin yesh mizzaro baolam?! veha ketiv: "lo nin lo velo neched beammo veen sarid bimgurav"! amra lo: zechor letorato, veal tizkor maasav. miyyad yarda esh vesichsecha safsalo shel rabbi. bacha veamar rabbi: uma lammitgannin bah — kach, lammishtabbechin bah — al achat kamma vechamma!

Verabbi meir, hechi gemar tora mippummeh deacher? vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: may dichtiv: "ki sifte chohen yishmeru daat vetora yevakshu mippihu ki malach Adonai tzevaot hu". im dome harav lemalach Adonai tzevaot — yevakkeshu tora mippihu, veim lav — al yevakkeshu tora mippihu!
Amar resh lakish: rabbi meir — kera ashkach uderash: "hat oznecha ushema divre chachamim velibbecha tashit ledati", "ledatam" lo neemar, ella "ledati".
Rav chanina amar mehacha: "shimi vat urei vehatti oznech veshichchi ammech uvet avich vegomer".
Kashu kerae ahadade? la kashya: ha begadol, ha bekatan.

Ki ata rav dimi, amar, amri bemareva: rabbi meir achal tachla, usheda shichla levara. daresh rava: may dichtiv: "el ginnat egoz yaradti lirot beibbe hannachal vegomer", lamma nimshelu talmide chachamim leegoz — lomar lach: ma egoz ze, af al pi shemmeluchelach betit uvetzoa — en ma shebbetocho nimas; af talmid chacham, af al pi shessarach — en torato nimeset.

Ashkecheh rabba bar shela leeliyyahu. amar leh: may ka aved hakkadosh baruch hu? amar leh: kaamar shemata mippummayyhu dechullehu rabbanan, umippummeh derabbi meir la kaamar. amar leh: ammay? mishshum deka gamar shemata mippummeh deacher. amar leh: ammay? rabbi meir rimmon matza, tocho achal, kelippato zarak. amar leh: hasheta kaamar, meir beni omer: bizman sheadam mitztaer, shechina ma lashon omeret: kallani meroshi, kallani mizzeroi. im kach hakkadosh baruch hu mitztaer al daman shel reshaim — kal vachomer al daman shel tzaddikim shennishpach.

Ashkecheh shemuel lerav yehuda ditle beivra dedashsha veka vache. amar leh: shinnana! may ka vachet? amar leh: mi zutera may dichtiv behu berabbanan: "ayye sofer ayye shokel ayye sofer et hammigdalim". "ayye sofer" — shehayu sofrim kol otiyyot shebbattora. "ayye shokel" — shehayu shoklim kallin vachamurin shebbattora. "ayye sofer et hammigdalim" — shehayu shonin shelosh meot halachot bemigdal happoreach baavir.

Veamar rabbi amme: telat mea baye beo doeg vaachitofel bemigdal happoreach baavir. utenan: shelosha melachim vearbaa hedyotot en lahem chelek laolam habba. anan ma tihve alan? amar leh: shinnana! tina hayta belibbam.
Acher may — zemer yevoni la pesak mippummeh. amru alav al acher: beshaa shehaya omed mibbet hammidrash, harebe sifre minin noshrin mecheko.
Shaal nimos haggardi et rabbi meir: kol amar denachet leyora salek? amar leh: kol man dahava neke aggav immeh — salek, kol dela hava neke aggav immeh — la salek.

Rabbi akiva ala beshalom veyarad beshalom, vealav hakkatuv omer: "moshcheni acharecha narutza". veaf rabbi akiva bikkeshu malache hashsharet ledochfo, amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: hannichu lezaken ze, sherauy lehishtammesh bichvodi.

a: May derash? amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: "veata merivvot kodesh" — ot hu barvava shello.
Verabbi avahu amar: "dagul mervava" — dugema hu barvava shello.
Veresh lakish amar: "Adonai tzevaot shemo" — adon hu batztzava shello.
Verabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: "lo varuach Adonai veachar haruach raash lo varaash Adonai. veachar haraash esh lo vaesh Adonai veachar haesh kol demama dakka", "vehinne Adonai over".

Tanu rabbanan, shishsha devarim neemru bashshedim: shelosha kemalache hashsharet, ushelosha kivne adam. shelosha kemalache hashsharet — yesh lahem kenafayim kemalache hashsharet, vetasin missof haolam vead sofo kemalache hashsharet, veyodin ma sheatid lihyot kemalache hashsharet.
Yodin salka datach?! ella, shomin meachore happargod, kemalache hashsharet.
Ushelosha kivne adam — ochlin veshotin kivne adam, parin veravin kivne adam, umetim kivne adam.

Shishsha devarim neemru bivne adam: shelosha kemalache hashsharet, shelosha kivhema. shelosha kemalache hashsharet — yesh lahem daat kemalache hashsharet, umehallechin bekoma zekufa kemalache hashsharet, umesapperim bilshon hakkodesh kemalache hashsharet. shelosha kivhema — ochlin veshotin kivhema, ufarin veravin kivhema, umotziin rei kivhema.
Kol hammistakkel bearbaa devarim ratuy lo shello ba laolam kulei. bishlama ma lemala ma lematta ma leachor — lechayye. ella lefanim — ma dahava hava?
Rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvayyhu: mashal lemelech basar vadam sheamar laavadav: benu li palterin gedolin al haashpa. halchu uvanu lo, en retzono shel melech lehazekir shem ashpa.

Kol shello chas al kevod kono, ratuy lo shello ba leolam. may hi? rabbi abba amar: ze hammistakkel bakkeshet. rav yosef amar: ze haover avera basseter. mistakkel bakkeshet, dichtiv: "kemare hakkeshet asher yihye veanan beyom haggeshem ken mare hannoga saviv hu mare demut kevod Adonai".

Rav yosef amar: ze haover avera basseter, kidrabbi yitzchak. deamar rabbi yitzchak: kol haover avera basseter, keillu dochek ragle shechina, shenneemar: "ko amar Adonai hashshamayim kisi vehaaretz hadom raglay".

Ini?! vehaamar rabbi ila hazzaken: im roe adam sheyyitzro mitgabber alav — yelech lemakom sheen makkirin oto, veyilbash shechorin veyitattef shechorin, veyaase ma shellibbo chafetz, veal yechallel shem shamayim befarhesya! la kashya: ha — dematze kayef leh leyitzreh, ha — dela matze kayef leyitzreh.

Daresh rabbi yehuda berabbi nachmani meturegmaneh deresh lakish: kol hammistakkel bishlosha devarim enav kehot: bakkeshet, uvannasi, uvakkohanim. bakkeshet — dichtiv: "kemare hakkeshet asher yihye veanan beyom haggeshem hu mare demut kevod Adonai". bannasi — dichtiv: "venatatta mehodcha alav". hammistakkel bakkohanim bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, shehayu omdin al duchanan umevarchin et yisrael bashshem hameforash.

Daresh rabbi yehuda berabbi nachmani meturegmaneh deresh lakish, may dichtiv: "al taaminu verea al tivtechu bealluf" — im yomar lecha yetzer hara, chato vehakkadosh baruch hu mochel al taamen, shenneemar: "al taaminu verea", veen "ra" ella yetzer hara shenneemar "ki yetzer lev haadam ra",

Veen "alluf" ella hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "alluf neuray atta". shemma tomar mi meid bi? avne veto vekorot beto shel adam hem meidin bo, shenneemar: "ki even mikkir tizak vechafis meetz yaanenna",

Vachachamim omrim: nishmato shel adam meida bo shenneemar "mishshochevet chekecha shemor pitche ficha", (i zo hi davar sheshshochevet) [e ze hu davar sheshsharuy] becheko shel adam — heve omer: zo neshama. rabbi zerika omer: shene malache hashsharet hamelavvin oto, hen meidin bo, shenneemar: "ki malachav yetzavve lach lishmarcha bechol derachecha". vachachamim omrim: evarav shel adam meidin bo, shenneemar: "veattem eday neum Adonai vaani el".

Mishna yose ben yoezer omer shello lismoch, yosef ben yochanan omer lismoch. yehoshua ben perachya omer shello lismoch, nittay haarbeli omer lismoch. yehuda ben tavay omer shello lismoch, shimon ben shatach omer lismoch. shemaya omer lismoch, avtalyon omer shello lismoch. hillel umenachem lo nechleku. yatza menachem, nichnas shammay. shammay omer shello lismoch, hillel omer lismoch.
b: Harishonim hayu nesiim, usheniyyim lahem avot bet din.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: shelosha mizzugot harishonim sheamru shello lismoch, ushenayim mizzugot haacharonim sheamru lismoch — (harishonim) hayu nesiim, usheniyyim lahem avot bet din, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: yehuda ben tavay — av bet din, veshimon ben shatach — nasi.
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan: amar rabbi yehuda ben tavay: ere benechama im lo haragti ed zomem, lehotzi millibban shel tzaddukin. shehayu omrim: en edim zommin neheragin ad sheyyehareg hanniddon.

Amar lo shimon ben shatach: ere benechama im lo shafachta dam naki, shehare amru chachamim: en edim zommin neheragin ad sheyyizzommu shenehem, veen lokin ad sheyyizzommu shenehem, veen meshallemin mamon ad sheyyizzommu shenehem.
Miyyad kibbel alav yehuda ben tavay sheeno more halacha ella bifne shimon ben shatach.

Kol yamav shel yehuda ben tavay haya mishtatteach al kivro shel oto harug, vehaya kolo nishma. kisvurin haam lomar shekkolo shel harug hu. amar lahem: koli hu. tedu, shellemachar hu met, veen kolo nishma.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: vedilma payyose payyeyseh, o bedina taveh.

Manni ha? i amrat bishlama, rabbi meir deamar shimon ben shatach av bet din, rabbi yehuda ben tavay nasi — hayeynu deka more halacha bifne shimon ben shatach. ella i amrat rabbanan deamri: yehuda ben tavay av bet din, shimon ben shatach nasi — av bet din bifne nasi mi more halacha?
La, may "kibbel alav" dekaamar — leitzterofe, daafillu itzterofe name la mitzterefna.

Yatza menachem venichnas shammay kulei. lehechan yatza? abbaye amar: yatza letarbut raa. rava amar: yatza laavodat hammelech. tanya name hachi: yatza menachem laavodat hammelech, veyatzu immo shemonim zugot talmidim levushin sirikon.
Amar rav shemen bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: leolam al tehe shevut kalla beenecha, shehare semicha enah ella mishshum shevut, venechleku bah gedole haddor.
Peshita? shevut mitzva itztericha leh.
Ha name peshita! leappoke mimman deamar bismicha gufa peligi, ka mashma lan bishvut hu difligi.
Amar rame bar chama: shema minna semicha bechol kocho baenan, dei salka datach la baenan bechol kocho — may ka aved? lismoch!
Metivi: "dabber el bene yisrael ... vesamach", bene yisrael somchin, veen benot yisrael somchot. rabbi yose verabbi yishmael omrim: benot yisrael somchot reshut.

Amar rabbi yose, sach li abba elazar: paam achat haya lanu egel shel zivche shelamim, vahavenuhu leezrat nashim, vesamchu alav nashim. lo mippene shessemicha benashim, ella kede laasot nachat ruach lannashim. vei salka datach semicha bechol kocho baenan — mishshum nachat ruach denashim avdinan avoda bekadashim? ella lav, shema minna la baenan bechol kocho!
Leolam ema lach baenan bechol kocho — daamar lehu: akpo yedayychu. i hachi, lo mippene shessemicha benashim, tippok leh deenah lismicha kelal!
Amar rabbi amme: chada veod kaamar. chada — deleta lismicha kelal, veod — kede laasot nachat ruach lannashim.
Amar rav pappa: shema minna — tzedadin asurin, dei salka datach tzedadin muttarin, lismoch litzdadin. ella lav, shema minna tzedadin asurin.

a: Rav ashe amar: afillu tema tzedadin muttarin, kol devahade gabba — kegabba dame.
Mishna bet shammay omrim: meviin shelamim, veen somchin alehem, aval lo olot. uvet hillel omrim: meviin shelamim veolot, vesomchin alehem.

Atzeret shechal lihyot beerev shabbat, bet shammay omrim: yom tevoach achar hashshabbat. uvet hillel omrim: en yom tevoach achar hashshabbat. umodim sheim chala lihyot beshabbat, sheyyom tevoach achar hashshabbat.
En kohen gadol mitlabbesh bechelav, umuttarin behesped uvetaanit, shello lekayyem divre haomrin: atzeret achar hashshabbat.

Gemara amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya: minnayin laatzeret sheyyesh lah tashlumin, kol shiva — shenneemar: "bechag hammatztzot uvechag hashshavuot uvechag hassukkot", makkish chag hashshavuot lechag hammatztzot: ma chag hammatztzot yesh lah tashlumin kol shiva — af chag hashshavuot yesh lah tashlumin kol shiva.
Veema: makkish lechag hassukkot, ma chag hassukkot yesh lah tashlumin kol shemona — af chag hashshavuot yesh lah tashlumin kol shemona! shemini regel bifne atzmo hu.

Emor deamri[nan] shemini regel bifne atzmo hu — hane mille leinyan pazer keshev. aval leinyan tashlumin — tashlumin derishon hu. ditnan: mi shello chag beyom tov harishon shel chag — chogeg et kol haregel, veyom tov haacharon.
Tafasta merubbe lo tafasta, tafasta muat tafasta.
Ella, lemay hilcheta katveh rachamana lechag hassukkot? leakkoshe lechag hammatztzot: ma chag hammatztzot taun lina — af chag hassukkot taun lina.
Vehatam menalan?
b: Dichtiv: "ufanita vabboker vehalachta leohalecha".

Tenan: atzeret shechal lihyot erev shabbat, bet shammay omrim: yom tevoach achar hashshabbat, uvet hillel omrim: en lah yom tevoach. may lav, en lah yom tevoach kelal? la, sheenah tzericha yom tevoach.

Umay ka mashma lan — dimkarvinan beyomeh, ha ippeligu ba chada zimna! ditnan, bet shammay omrim: meviin shelamim veen somchin alehem, aval lo olot, uvet hillel omrim: meviin shelamim veolot vesomchin alehem.
Tzericha, dei ashmeinan beha: beha ka amri bet shammay, mishshum deefshar limchar. aval hacha, ema modu lehu levet hillel.
Vei ashmeinan beha: beha kaamri bet hillel, mishshum dela efshar limchar, aval beha — ema modu levet shammay, tzericha.

Ta shema: mi shello chag shivat yeme happesach, ushemonat yeme hechag, veyom tov harishon shel atzeret, shuv eno chogeg. may lav: yom tov shel atzeret! lo, yom tevoach. i hachi, nifshot minna dechad yom tevoach! ema: yeme tevoach.

Ta shema, detane rabba bar shemuel: amra tora mene yamim vekaddesh chodesh, mene yamim vekaddesh atzeret. ma chodesh — limnuyav, af atzeret — limnuyeha. may lav: gamar mechodesh, ma chodesh — yom echad, af atzeret — yom echad!

Amar rava: vetisbera?! attu atzeret, yome manenan shavue la manenan? vehaamar abbaye: mitzva lemimne yome, dichtiv: "tisperu chamishshim yom", umitzva lemimne shavue, dichtiv: "shiva shavuot tispar lach". veod: "chag shavuot", ketiv.
Deve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov tana, amar kera: "ukeratem uvekutzrechem". ezehu chag sheatta kore vekotzer bo — heve omer ze chag atzeret.
Emat? illema beyom tov — ketzira beyom tov mi shere? ella lav letashlumin.

Veaf al gav deittemar derabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya, itzterich derabbi eliezer ben yaakov. dei midderabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya — hava amena: ma tashlumin shel chag hammatztzot asur baasiyyayt melacha, af tashlume atzeret name asur baasiyyayt melacha, kamashma lan derabbi eliezer ben yaakov. vei midderabbi eliezer ben yaakov,

a: La yadana kamma, ka mashma lan derabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya.
Veresh lakish amar: "vechag hakkatzir", ezehu chag sheatta chogeg vekotzer bo — heve omer ze atzeret. emat? illema beyom tov — ketzira beyom tov mi shere? ella lav letashlumin.

Amar rabbi yochanan: ella meatta, "chag haasif": e zehu chag sheyyesh bo asifa — heve omer ze chag hassukkot, emat? illema beyom tov — melacha beyom tov mi shere? ella bechullo shel moed. chullo shel moed mi shere? ella — chag habba bizman asifa, hacha name — chag habba bizman ketzira.
Mikkelal detarvayyhu sevira lehu dechullo shel moed asur baasiyyayt melacha.

Menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "et chag hammatztzot tishmor shivat yamim" — limmed al chullo shel moed sheasur baasiyyayt melacha, divre rabbi yoshiyya. rabbi yonatan omer: eno tzarich, kal vachomer: uma rishon ushevii sheen kedushsha lifnehen uleacharehen — asur baasiyyayt melacha, chullo shel moed sheyyesh kedushsha lifnehen uleacharehen — eno din sheyyehe asur baasiyyayt melacha.

Sheshet yeme vereshit yochichu, sheyyesh kedushsha lifnehen uleacharehen, umuttarin baasiyyayt melacha! ma lesheshet yeme bereshit sheen bahen korban musaf, tomar bechullo shel moed sheyyesh bo korban musaf. rosh chodesh yochiach, sheyyesh bo korban musaf, umuttar baasiyyayt melacha! ma lerosh chodesh sheen karuy "mikra kodesh", tomar bechullo shel moed shekkaruy "mikra kodesh", hoil vekaruy "mikra kodesh" — din hu sheasur baasiyyayt melacha.

Tanya iddach: "kol melechet avoda lo taasu" — limmed al chullo shel moed sheasur baasiyyayt melacha, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer: "elle moade Adonai vegomer". bamma hakkatuv medabber? im barishon — hare kevar neemar "shabbaton", im bashshevii — hare kevar neemar "shabbaton". ha en hakkatuv medabber ella bechullo shel moed, lelammedcha sheasur baasiyyayt melacha.

Tanya iddach: "sheshet yamim tochal matztzot uvayyom hashshevii atzeret laAdonai", ma shevii atzur — af sheshet yamim atzurin. i: ma shevii atzur bechol melacha — af sheshet yamim atzurin bechol melacha.

Talmud lomar: "uvayyom hashshevii atzeret", hashshevii atzur bechol melacha, veen shishsha yamim atzurin bechol melacha. ha lo mesaran hakkatuv ella lachachamim, lomar lach e ze yom asur vee ze yom muttar, e zo melacha asura vee zo melacha mutteret.

Umuttarin behesped vetaanit, shello lekayyem et divre haomrin atzeret achar hashshabbat. vehaittemar: maase umet alekkesa belod, venichnesu kol yisrael lesofdo, velo hinnicham rabbi tarfon, mippene sheyyom tov shel atzeret haya.
Yom tov salka datach? i beyom tov, mi kaatu? ella ema: mippene sheyyom tevoach haya! la kashya: kan beyom tov shechal lihyot achar hashshabbat, kan beyom tov shechal lihyot beshabbat.
b: Mishna notlin layyadayim lachullin velammaaser velatteruma, velakkodesh — matbilin. velachattat — im nitmeu yadav, nitma gufo.

Taval lachullin, huchezak lachullin — asur lammaaser. taval lammaaser, huchezak lammaaser — asur latteruma. taval latteruma, huchezak latteruma — asur lakkodesh. taval lakkodesh, huchezak lakkodesh — asur lachattat. taval lechamur — muttar lakkal. taval velo huchezak — keillu lo taval.
Bigde am haaretz, midras lifrushin. bigde ferushin, midras leochle teruma. bigde ochle teruma, midras lakkodesh. bigde kodesh, midras lachattat.
Yosef ben yoezer haya chasid shebbakkehunna, vehayta mitpachto midras lakkodesh. yochanan ben gudegda haya ochel al tohorat hakkodesh kol yamav, vehayta mitpachto midras lachattat.
Gemara chullin umaaser mi bau netilat yadayim?

Ureminhi: hatteruma vehabbikkurim chayyayvin alehen mita vachomesh, vaasuri[yn] lezarim, vehen nichse chohen. veolin beechad umea, uteunin netilat yadayim veheerev shemesh. hare ellu bitruma uvikkurim, ma sheen ken bammaaser, vechol shekken bachullin.
Kashya maaser ammaaser, kashya chullin achullin!
Bishlama maaser ammaaser la kashya: ha rabbi meir veha rabbanan.
Ditnan: kol hattaun biat mayim middivre sofrim — metamme et hakkodesh, ufosel et hatteruma, umuttar lachullin ulemaaser, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim osrim bemaaser. ella chullin achullin kashya!
La kashya: kan baachila, kan bingia.

Matkef la rav shimi bar ashe: ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi meir ella baachila demaaser, aval bingia demaaser uvaachila dechullin la peligi? ella: idde veidde baachila, vela kashya: kan baachila denahama, kan baachila defere. deamar rav nachman: kol hannotel yadav leferot — hare ze miggasse haruach.

Tanu rabbanan: hannotel yadav, nitkavvevn — yadav tehorot, lo nitkavvevn — yadav temeot. vechen hammatbil yadav, nitkavvevn — yadav tehorot, lo nitkavvevn — yadav temeot. vehatanya: ben nitkavvevn ben lo nitkavvevn — yadav tehorot! amar rav nachman, la kashya: kan lechullin,

a: Kan lemaaser. umena temra dechullin la bau kauona — ditnan: gal shennitlash uvo arbaim sea, venafal al haadam veal hakkelim — tehorin. katane adam dumeya dechelim, ma kelim dela mechavvevni — af adam dela mechavven.
Umimmay? dilma beyoshev umetzappe ematay yittalesh haggal askinan, vechelim dumeya deadam, ma adam devar kauona — af kelim dimchavven lehu.
Vechi tema beyoshev umetzappe, may lememra?
Salka datach amena: ligzor dilma ate lemitbal bechardalit shel geshamim, i name nigzor rashin attu kippin, ka mashma lan dela gazrinan.
Umena temra dela matbilin bechippin, detanya: matbilin berashin, veen matbilin bechippin, lefi sheen matbilin baavir.
Ella meha ditnan: perot shennaflu letoch ammat hammayim, ufashat mi sheyyadav temeot unetalan — yadav tehorot, uferot enan bechi yuttan".
Veim bishvil sheyyudechu yadav — yadav tehorot, vehapperot hare hen bechi yuttan".
Etiveh rabba lerav nachman: hattovel lechullin vehuchezak lechullin — asur lemaaser. huchezak — in, lo huchezak — la!
Hachi kaamar: af al pi shehuchezak lechullin — asur lemaaser.
Etiveh: taval velo huchezak — keillu lo taval, may lav — keillu lo taval kelal?
Lo, keillu lo taval lemaaser, aval taval lechullin. hu savar dachoye ka medache leh. nefak dak veashkach detanya: taval velo huchezak — asur lammaaser umuttar lachullin.
Amar rabbi elazar: taval veala — machzik atzmo lechol ma sheyyirtze.
Metivi: odehu raglo achat bammayim, huchezak ledavar kal — machzik atzmo ledavar chamur, ala — shuv eno machzik.
May lav — eno machzik kelal!
Lo: odehu, af al pi shehuchezak — machzik, ala, im lo huchezak — machzik, veim huchezak — eno machzik.

Man tanna odehu raglo achat bammayim? amar rabbi pedat: rabbi yehuda hi. ditnan: mikve shennimdad veyesh bo arbaim sea mechuuonot, veyardu shenayim vetavlu ze achar ze — harishon tahor, vehashsheni tame. amar rabbi yehuda: im hayu raglav shel rishon nogot bammayim — af hashsheni tahor.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: machloket bemaalot derabbanan, aval mittumea letohora — divre hakkol af hashsheni tame. vehayeynu derabbi pedat.
Ikka deamri, amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: machloket mittumea letohora, aval bemaalot derabbanan — divre hakkol af hashsheni tahor. ufeliga derabbi pedat.
Amar ulla, bae minneh merabbi yochanan: lerabbi yehuda, mahu lehatebil mechatin vetzinnoriyyot berosho shel rishon?
Gud achet it leh lerabbi yehuda, gud assek let leh, o dilma: gud assek name it leh?

Amar leh, tenetuha: shalosh gemamiyyot bannachal, haelyona, hattachtona vehaemtzait; haelyona vehattachtona shel esrim esrim sea, vehaemtzait shel arbaim sea, vechardalit shel geshamim overet benehen, rabbi yehuda omer: meir haya omer: matbil baelyona.
Vehatanya, rabbi yehuda omer:
b: Meir haya omer: matbil baelyona, vaani omer: battachtona velo baelyona! amar leh: i tanya — tanya.
Hattovel lachullin vehuchezak lachullin kulei. manni matnitin — rabbanan hi, deshane lehu ben chullin lemaaser.
Ema sefa: bigde am haaretz, midras lifrushin. bigde ferushin, midras leochle teruma.
Atan lerabbi meir, deamar: chullin umaaser kahadade ninhu, resha rabbanan vesefa rabbi meir?! in, resha rabbanan vesefa rabbi meir.
Rav acha bar adda matne la besefa chamesh maalot, umoke la kullah kerabbanan.
Amar rav mari: shema minna chullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh — kekodesh damu. mimmay —

a: Middela katane behu maala.

Vedilma hay dela katane behu maala, dei damu litruma — ha tane teruma, vei damu lechullin — ha tane lechullin. ditnan: chullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh — hare hen kechullin, rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer: hare hen kitruma.
Ella missefa: yose ben yoezer haya chasid shebbakkehunna, vehayta mitpachto midras lakkodesh. yochanan ben gudegda haya ochel al tohorat hakkodesh kol yamav, vehayta mitpachto midras lachattat.
Lachattat in, lakkodesh la. alma kasavar: chullin shennaasu al tohorat kodesh kekodesh damu.

Amar rabbi yonatan ben elazar: nafla maporto hemennu, amar lachavero: "tenah li" unetanah lo — temea. amar rabbi yonatan ben amram: nitchallefu lo kelim shel shabbat bechelim shel chol ulevashan — nitmeu.
Amar rabbi elazar bar tzadok: maase bishte nashim chaverot shennitchallefu lahen kelehen bevet hammerchatz, uva maase lifne rabbi akiva vetimmean.
Matkef la rabbi oshaya: ella meatta, hoshit yado lassal littol pat chittin vealta beyado pat seorim, hachi name denitmet?
Vechi tema hachi name — vehatanya: hameshammer et hechavit bechezkat shel yayin venimtzet shel shemen — tehora milletamme! uletamaych, ema sefa: vaasura milleechol. ammay?
Amar rabbi yirmeya, beomer: shemartiha middavar hametammeah velo middavar happoslah.

Umi ikka netiruta lefalga? in, vehatanya: hoshit yado besal, vehassal al ketefo, vehammagrefa betoch hassal, vehaya belibbo al hassal velo haya belibbo al hammagrefa — hassal tahor vehammagrefa temea.
Hassal tahor? tetamme hammagrefa lassal! en keli metamme keli. velittame ma shebbassal! amar ravina, beomer: shemartiv middavar shemmetammeo velo middavar happoslo.
Mikkol makom kashya?

Veod motev rabba bar avu: maase beishsha achat shebbat lifne rabbi yishmael, veamra lo: rabbi, beged ze aragtiv betohora, velo haya belibbi leshomro betohora. umittoch bedikot shehaya rabbi yishmael bodkah, amra lo: rabbi, nidda mashcha immi bachevel. amar rabbi yishmael: kamma gedolim divre chachamim, shehayu omrim: belibbo leshomro — tahor, en belibbo leshomro — tame.

Shuv maase beishsha achat shebbat lifne rabbi yishmael, amra lo: rabbi, mappa zo aragtiha betohora, velo haya belibbi leshomrah. umittoch bedikot shehaya rabbi yishmael bodkah, amra lo: rabbi, nima nifseka li ukeshartiha bappe.
Amar rabbi yishmael: kamma gedolim divre chachamim, shehayu omrim: belibbo leshomro — tahor, en belibbo leshomro — tame.
Bishlama lerabbi elazar bar tzadok, kol achat veachat omeret: chaverti eshet am haaretz, umassecha data minna.
Lerabbi yonatan ben amram name, kevan dechelim deshabbat aved lehu shimmur tefe — massach dateh minnayyhu. ella lerabbi yonatan ben elazar, naaved lehu shimmur bideh dechavreh?
Amar rabbi yochanan: chazaka, en adam meshammer ma shebbeyad chavero. velo?
b: Vehatanya: hare shehayu chamarav ufoalav teunin teharot, af al pi shehiflig mehen yoter mimmil — taharotav tehorot. veim amar lahem: "lechu vaani avo acharechem", kevan shennitallemu enav mehen — taharotav temeot.
May shena resha umay shena sefa? amar rabbi yitzchak nappacha: resha bimtaher chamarav ufoalav lechach.
I hachi, sefa name! en am haaretz makpid al magga chavero.
I hachi, resha name! beva lahem derech akallaton.
I hachi, sefa name! kevan daamar lehu "lechu vaani avo acharechem" — mismach samcha datayyhu.
Hadaran alach en dorshin
Chomer bakkodesh mibbitruma, shemmatbilin kelim betoch kelim litruma, aval lo lakkodesh. achorayim vatoch uvet hatztzevita bitruma, aval lo bakkodesh.
Hannose et hammidras, nose et hatteruma, aval lo et hakkodesh. bigde ochle teruma, midras lakkodesh.
Lo kemiddat hakkodesh middat hatteruma. shebbakkodesh: mattir umenaggev umatbil, veachar kach kosher. uvitruma: kosher, veachar kach matbil.
Kelim hannigmarim betohora, tzerichin tevila lakkodesh, aval lo litruma. hakkeli metzaref ma shebbetocho lakkodesh, aval lo litruma.

Harvii bakkodesh pasul, vehashshelishi vitruma. uvitruma, im nitmet achat miyyadav — chavertah tehora, uvakkodesh — matbil shetehen, shehayyad metamme et chavertah bakkodesh aval lo vitruma. ochlin ochalim neguvin beyadayim mesoavot vitruma, aval lo bakkodesh.

a: Haonen umechussar kippurim tzerichin tevila lakkodesh, aval lo litruma.
Gemara bakkodesh may tama la? amar rabbi ila: mippene shekkevedo shel keli chotzetz.

Veha middesefa mishshum chatzitza, resha lav mishshum chatzitza! dekatane sefa: velo kemiddat hakkodesh middat hatteruma, shebbakkodesh mattir umenaggev umatbil veachar kach kosher, uvatteruma kosher veachar kach matbil!

Resha vesefa mishshum chatzitza, utzericha: dei ashmeinan resha, hava amena hayeynu tama dilkodesh la — mishshum kevedo shel keli deikka, aval sefa, delekka kevedo shel keli — ema lekodesh name la have chatzitza. vei ashmeinan sefa, hava amena: hayeynu tama dilkodesh la, mishshum
b: Dekitra bemayya ihaddoke mihaddak, aval resha, demayya akpoye makpu leh lemana — la havya chatzitza, tzericha.

Rabbi ila letameh, deamar rabbi ila amar rabbi chanina bar pappa: eser maalot shanu kan, chamesh rishonot — ben lakkodesh, ben lechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh, acharonot — lakkodesh, aval lo lechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh.

May tama: chamesh kammayayta, deit lehu derara detumea middeorayyta — gezaru behu rabbanan ben lekodesh ben lechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh, batrayayta, delet lehu derara detumea middeorayyta — gezaru behu rabbanan lekodesh, lechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh — la gezaru behu rabbanan.

Rava amar: middesefa have mishshum chatzitza, resha lav mishshum chatzitza. veresha, hayeynu tama: gezera shello yatbil mechatin vetzinnorot bichli sheen befiv kishfoferet hannod. keditnan: eruv mikvoot, kishfoferet hannod, keovyah

a: Vechachalalah, bishte etzbaot chozrot limkoman.

Savar la keha deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: achat esre maalot shanu kan: shesh rishonot — ben lakkodesh, ben lechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh. acharonot — lakkodesh, aval lo lechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh.
May ikka ben derava lidrabbi ila?

Ikka benayyhu sal vegarguteni shemmillean kelim vehitbilan. leman deamar mishshum chatzitza — ikka. leman deamar mishshum gezera shemma yatbil mechatin vetzinnoriyyot bichli sheen befiv kishfoferet hannod — sal vegarguteni sheen befihen kishfoferet hannod, lekka.
Veazda rava letameh, deamar rava: sal vegarguteni shemmillean kelim vehitbilan — tehorin.
Umikve shechalako besal vegarguteni — hattovel sham lo alta lo tevila. deha ara kulla chalchole mechalchala, uvaenan deikka arbaim sea bemakom echad.
Vehane mille bichli tahor, aval bichli tame, miggo desalka tevila lechulleh gufeh demana, salka lehu name lechelim deit beh.

Ditnan: kelim shemmillean kelim vehitbilan — hare ellu tehorin. veim lo taval, mayim hameoravim — ad sheyyihyu meoravin kishfoferet hannod. may kaamar veim lo taval? hachi kaamar: veim eno tzarich lehatebilo, umayim hameoravin ad sheyyehu meoravin kishfoferet hannod.
Veha derava uderabbi ila tannae hi. detanya: sal vegarguteni shemmillean kelim vehitbilan ben lakkodesh ben latteruma, tehorin. abba shaul omer: latteruma aval lo lakkodesh.
I hachi, teruma name! leman kaamrinan — chaverim, chaverim midda yadi.
I hachi, kodesh name! chaze leh am haaretz veazel matbil.
Teruma name, chaze leh am haaretz veazel matbil! la mekabbelinan minnayyhu.
Kodesh name, la nekabbel minnayyhu! havya leh eva.
Teruma name, havya leh eva! la ichpat leh, deazel yahev leh lechohen am haaretz chavreh.

Uman tanna dechayesh leeva — rabbi yose hi. detanya, amar rabbi yose: mippene ma hakkol neemanin al tohorat yayin vashemen kol yemot hashshana — kede shello yehe kol echad veechad holech uvone bama leatzmo, vesoref para adumma leatzmo.
Amar rav pappa: keman mekabbelinan haiddana sahaduta meam haaretz — keman kerabbi yose.
Venechush lishela.
Ditnan: keli cheres matztzil al hakkol, divre bet hillel. bet shammay omrim: eno matztzil ella al ochalim veal hammashkim veal kele cheres.

Amru lahem bet hillel levet shammay: mippene ma? amru bet shammay: mippene shehu tame al gabbe am haaretz, veen keli tame chotzetz. amru lahem bet hillel: vahalo tihartem ochalin umashkin shebbetocho! amru lahem bet shammay: keshettiharnu ochalin umashkin shebbetocho —
b: Leatzmo tiharnu.
Aval netaher et hakkeli, shettohorato lecha valo?

Tanya, amar rabbi yehoshua: boshani middivrechem, bet shammay! efshar ishsha lasha baareva — ishsha vaareva temein shiva, uvatzek tahor? login male mashkin — login tame tumeat shiva, umashkin tehorin?!

Nitpal lo talmid echad mittalmide bet shammay, amar lo: omar lecha taman shel bet shammay. amar lo: emor. amar lo: keli tame — chotzetz o eno chotzetz? amar lo: eno chotzetz. keli shel am haaretz — tame o tahor? amar lo: tame. veim atta omer lo "tame", kelum mashgiach alecha? velo od, ella sheim atta omer lo "tame", omer lecha: "shelli tahor veshellecha tame".
Vezehu taman shel bet shammay.

Miyyad halach rabbi yehoshua venishtattach al kivre bet shammay, amar: naaneti lachem atzmot bet shammay! uma setumot shellachem kach, meforashot — al achat kamma vechamma. amru: kol yamav hushecharu shinnav mippene taaniyyotav.
Katane mihat "lecha valo", alma shaalinan minnayyhu! ki shayylinan minnayyhu matbelinan lehu.
I hachi, nayhderu lehu bet hillel levet shammay: ki shaalinan minnayyhu matbelinan lehu! teme met bae hazzaa shelishi ushevii, umana leshiva yome la moshli inashe.
Veattevila la mehemni? vehatanya: neemanin amme haaretz al tohorat tevilat teme met!

Amar abbaye, la kashya: ha begufo, ha bechelav. rava amar: idde veidde bechelav, vela kashya: ha deamar "meolam lo hitbalti keli betoch keli", veha deamar "hitbalti, aval lo hitbalti bichli sheen befiv kishfoferet hannod".
Vehatanya: neeman am haaretz lomar perot lo hucheshru, aval eno neeman lomar perot hucheshru aval lo nitmeu.
Veaggufo mi meheman? vehatanya: chaver shebba lehazzot — mazzin alav miyyad, am haaretz shebba lehazzot — en mazzin alav ad sheyyaase befanenu shelishi ushevii!
Ella amar abbaye: mittoch chomer shehechmarta alav bitchillato, hekalta alav besofo.
Achorayim vatoch. may achorayim vatoch?
Keditnan: keli shennitma achorav bemashkin — achorav temein, tocho, ogno, ozno, veyadav — tehorin. nitma tocho — kullo tame.

Uvet hatztzevita vechulei. may bet hatztzevita? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: makom shetztzovto, vechen hu omer: "vayyitzbot lah kali". rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: makom shennekiyye haddaat tzovin.

Tane rav bivi kammeh derav nachman: kol hakkelim en lahem achorayim vatoch, echad kodshe hammikdash veechad kodshe haggevul. amar leh: kodshe haggevul may ninhu — teruma, vehatnan: achorayim vatoch uvet hatztzevita litruma!
Dilma lechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh kaamrat.

Adkartan milleta deamar rabba bar avu: achat esre maalot shanu kan; shesh rishonot — ben lakkodesh, ben lechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh, acharonot — lakkodesh, aval lo lechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh.

Hannose et hammidras — nose et hatteruma, aval lo et hakkodesh. kodesh, may tama la? mishshum maase shehaya. deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: maase beechad shehaya maavir chavit shel yen kodesh mimmakom lemakom,

a: Venifseka retzua shel sandalo, unetalah vehinnichah al pi chavit, venafla laavir hechavit, venitmet. beotah shaa amru: hannose et hammidras — nose et hatteruma, aval lo et hakkodesh.
I hachi, teruma name! ha manni — rabbi chananya ben akavya hi, deamar: lo asru ella bayyarden uvisfina, uchemaase shehaya.

May hi? detanya: lo yissa adam me chattat veefer chattat veyaavirem bayyarden uvisfina, velo yaamod betzad ze veyizrekem letzad acher, velo yeshitem al pene hammayim, velo yirkav al gabbe behema, velo al gabbe chavero, ella im ken hayu raglav nogot bakkarka. aval maaviran al gabbe haggesher veeno choshesh; echad hayyarden veechad shear hanneharot. rabbi chananya ben akavya omer: lo asru ella bayyarden uvisfina, uchemaase shehaya.

May maase shehaya? deamar rav yehuda amar rav: maase beadam echad shehaya maavir me chattat veefer chattat bayyarden uvisfina venimtza kezayit met tachuv bekarkaitah shel sefina. beotah shaa amru: lo yissa adam me chattat veefer chattat veyaavirem bayyarden bisfina.
Ibbaya lehu: sandal tame, sandal tahor mahu? chavit petucha, chavit setuma mahu? avar venasa mahu?
Rabbi ila amar: im avar venasa — tame. rabbi zera amar: avar venasa — tahor.
Kelim hannigmarim betohora kulei. degamrinhu man? ilema degamrinhu chaver, lema lehu tevila?
Ella degamrinhu am haaretz — nigmarin betohora kare lehu? amar rabba bar shela amar rav matna amar shemuel: leolam degamrinhu chaver, umishshum tzinnora deam haaretz.
Dinfal emat? illema mikkamme deligmereh — ha lav mana hu. ella batar degamreh — mizhar zehir behv! leolam mikkammeh degamreh, vedilma beiddana degamreh adayin lacha hi.
Tevila in, heerev shemesh la.

Matnitin dela kerabbi eliezer, ditnan: shefoferet shechatachah lechattat, rabbi eliezer omer: yitbol miyyad. rabbi yehoshua omer: yetamme veachar kach yitbol. vehavenan ba: dechatcha man? ilema dechatcha chaver — lema li tevila? veella dechatcha am haaretz, beha lema rabbi yehoshua yetamme veyitbol? ha tame vekae!

Veamar rabba bar shela amar rav matna amar shemuel: leolam dechatcha chaver, umishshum tzinnora deam haaretz. dinfal emat? illema mikkamme delichtecha — ha lav mana hu, veella batar dechatcha — mizhar zehir ba! leolam mikkamme delichtecha, dilma beiddana dechatcha adayin lacha hi.
Bishlama lerabbi yehoshua, hayeynu deikka hekkera letzaddukin.
Ditnan: metammein hayu et hakkohen hassoref et happara, lehotzi millibban shel tzaddukin. shehayu omrim: bimorve shemesh hayta naaset.
Ella lerabbi eliezer, i amrat bishlama bealma baenan heerev shemesh, hayeynu deikka hekkera letzaddukin. ella i amrat bealma la baenan heerev shemesh — may hekkera letzaddukin ikka?
Amar rav:
b: Asauha kitme sheretz.
Ella meatta, lo tetamme adam, allema tanya: chotchah umatbilah — taun tevila! veella: asauha kitme met. i hachi tive hazzaat shelishi ushevii,
Allema tanya: chotchah umatbilah — taun tevila. tevila in, hazzaat shelishi ushevii la! ella: asauha kitme met bishvii shello,
Vehatanya: meolam lo chiddeshu davar bappara.
Amar abbaye: shello amru kuredom metamme moshav. kidtanya: "vehayyoshev al hakkeli". yachol kafa sea veyashav aleha, tarkav veyashav aleha — yehe tame,
Talmud lomar: "vehayyoshev al hakkeli asher yeshev alav ... yitma" — mi shemyuchad lishiva, yatza ze, sheomrim lo: amod venaase melachtenu.
Hakkeli metzaref ma shebbetocho lakkodesh, aval lo latteruma. mena hane mille? amar rabbi chanin, deamar kera: "kaf achat asara zahav melea ketoret", hakkatuv asao lechol ma shebbakkaf — achat.
Metiv rav kahana: hosif rabbi akiva hassolet, vehakketoret, vehallevona, vehaggechalim, sheim naga tevul yom bemiktzato — pasal et kullo.
Veha derabbanan hi. mimmay, middekatane resha: heid rabbi shimon ben betera al efer chattat shennaga hattame bemiktzato — shettimme et kullo, vekatane: hosif rabbi akiva!
Amar resh lakish mishshum bar kappara:

a: Lo nitzrecha ella lishyare mincha. deorayyta, tzarich lichli — hakkeli metzarfo, sheen tzarich lichli — en keli metzarfo.
Vaato rabbanan ugezaru deaf al gav deeno tzarich lichli — keli metzarfo.

Tinach solet, ketoret ulevona may ikka lememar? amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: kegon shetztzevaran al gabbe kartevula. deorayyta, yesh lo toch — metzaref, en lo toch — eno metzaref, vaato rabbanan vetakkinu deaf al gav deen lo toch — metzaref.
Ufeliga derabbi chanin adderabbi chiyyay bar abba. deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: meeduto shel rabbi akiva nishnet mishna zo.

Harvii bakkodesh pasul. tanya, amar rabbi yose: minnayin larvii bakkodesh shehu pasul — vedin hu: uma mechussar kippurim shemmuttar batteruma — pasul bakkodesh, shelishi sheppasul batteruma — eno din sheyyaase revii lakkodesh? velamadnu shelishi lakkodesh min hattora, urevii bekal vachomer.
Shelishi lakkodesh min hattora minnayin? dichtiv: "vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel", mi la askinan dinga besheni, vekaamar rachamana "lo yeachel". revii mikkal vachomer — ha daamaran.
Uvatteruma im nitmet kulei. amar rav shezvi: bechibburin shanu, aval shello bechibburin — lo.
Etiveh abbaye: yad neguva metamma chavertah letamme lakkodesh, aval lo latteruma, divre rabbi. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: lifsol, aval lo letamme.
I amrat bishlama shello bechibburin — hayeynu revutay dinguva. ella i amrat bechibburin — in, shello bechibburin — la, may revuta dinguva?
Ittemar name, amar resh lakish: lo shanu ella yado,
b: Aval yad chavero — lo. verabbi yochanan amar: echad yado veechad yad chavero, beotah hayyad. lifsol, aval lo letamme.
Mimmay — middekatane sefa: shehayyad metammea chavertah lakkodesh, aval lo latteruma. ha tu lema li? ha tena leh resha! ella lav shema minna, leetoye yad chavero.
Veaf resh lakish hadar beh, deamar rabbi yona amar rabbi amme amar resh lakish: echad yado veechad yad chavero, beotah hayyad, lifsol aval lo letamme.

Velifsol aval lo letamme tannae hi. ditnan: kol happosel bitruma — metamme yadayim lihyot sheniyyot, veyad metamme chavertah, divre rabbi yehoshua. vachachamim omrim: yadayim sheniyyot hen, veen sheni ose sheni bachullin.
May lav: sheni hu dela aved, ha shelishi aved.
Dilma la sheni aved vela shelishi.
Ella ki hane tannae, detanya: yad neguva metamma et chavertah letamme bakkodesh, aval lo latteruma, divre rabbi. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: otah yad lifsol, aval lo letamme.
Ochlin ochalim neguvin beyadayim mesoavot kulei. tanya, amar rabbi chanina ben antignos: vechi yesh neguva lakkodesh? vahalo chibbat hakkodesh machshartan.
La tzericha, kegon shettachav lo chavero letoch piv, o shettachav hu leatzmo bechush uvecharker, uvikkesh leechol tzenon uvatzal shel chullin immahen.
Lekodesh gezaru behu rabbanan, litruma la gezaru behu rabbanan.
Haonen umechussar kippurim kulei. may tama — kevan dead haiddana havo asiri, atzrechinhu rabbanan tevila.
Mishna chomer batteruma, shebbihuda neemanin al tohorat yayin vashemen kol yemot hashshana, uvishat haggittot vehabbaddim — af al hatteruma.
Avru haggittot vehabbaddim, veheviu lo chavit shel yayin shel teruma — lo yekabbelenna mimmennu, aval mannichah laggat habbaa. veim amar lo hifrashti letochah reviit kodesh — neeman.
Kadde yayin vechadde shemen

a: Hamedummaot — neemanin alehem bishat haggittot vehabbaddim, vekodem laggittot shivim yom.
Gemara bihuda in, uvaggalil la, may tama?
Amar resh lakish: mippene shertzua shel kutim mafseket benehen.

Venetev beshidda teva umigdal? ha manni — rabbi hi, deamar: ohel zaruk — lav shemeh ohel. detanya: hannichnas leeretz haammim beshidda teva umigdal, rabbi metamme, verabbi yose berabbi yehuda metaher.
Velayytu bichli cheres hammukkaf tzamid patil! amar rabbi eliezer, shonin: en hakkodesh nitztzol betzamid patil.
Vehatanya: en chattat nitztzolet betzamid patil. may lav: ha kodesh nitztzol! la: ha mayim sheenan mekuddashim nitztzolin betzamid patil.
Vehaamar ulla: chavrayyay medakkan begalila! mannichin, lichsheyyavo eliyyahu vitaharenna.
Uvishat haggittot neemanin af al hatteruma. ureminhi: haggomer zetav — yeshayyer kuppa achat veyittenenna leani kohen!
Amar rav nachman, la kashya: ha becharfe, ha beafle. amar leh rav adda bar ahava: kegon may? keotan shel bet avicha.

Rav yosef amar: begalila shanu. etiveh abbaye: ever hayyarden vehaggalil — hare hen kihuda, neemanin al hayyayin bishat hayyayin veal hashshemen bishat hashshemen, aval lo al hayyayin bishat hashshemen velo al hashshemen bishat hayyayin.
Ella mechavvavrta kidshannin meikkara.

Avru haggittot vehabbaddim veheviu lo chavit shel yayin — lo yekabbelenna hemennu, aval mannichah laggat habbaa. beo minneh merav sheshet: avar vekibbelah, mahu sheyyannichenna laggat habbaa? amar lehu: tenetuha:
b: Chaver veam haaretz sheyyarshu et avihem am haaretz, yachol lomar lo: tol atta chittin shebbemakom peloni, vaani chittin shebbemakom peloni.
Tol atta yayin shebbemakom peloni, vaani yayin shebbemakom peloni.
Aval lo yomar lo: tol atta lach vaani yavesh, tol atta chittin vaani seorim.
Vetane ala: oto chaver soref hallach, umanniach et hayyavesh.
Ammay? yannichenna laggat habbaa! baddavar sheen lo gat. veyannichennu laregel! bedavar sheeno mishtammer laregel.
Veim amar hifrashti letochah reviit kodesh — neeman. tenan hatam: modin bet shammay uvet hillel shebbodkin leose fesach, veen bodkin leochle teruma.
May bodkin? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: menappeach adam bet happeras veholech.
Verabbi chiyyay bar abba mishshemeh deulla amar: bet happeras shenniddash — tahor leose fesach. lo heemidu divrehen bimkom karet.
Leochle teruma heemidu divrehen bimkom mita.
Ibbaya lehu: badak lefischo, mahu sheyyochal bitrumato? ulla amar: badak lefischo — muttar leechol bitrumato. rabba bar ulla amar: badak lefischo — asur leechol bitrumato.

Amar leh hahu sava: la tiflog aleh deulla, ditnan kevoteh: veim amar hifrashti letochah reviit kodesh — neeman, alma: middimheman akkodesh meheman name atteruma, hacha name: middimheman appesach, meheman name atteruma.

Kadde yayin vechadde shemen kulei. tana: en neemanin lo al hakkankannim velo al hatteruma. kankannim demay? i kankannim dekodesh — miggo dimheman akkodesh, meheman name akkankannim! ella kankannim ditruma — peshita, hasheta atteruma la meheman, akkankannim meheman?
Ella berekanim dekodesh uvishar yemot hashshana, uvimlein ditruma uvishat haggittot.
Tenan: kadde yayin vechadde shemen hamedummaot. may lav, medummaot ditruma. amri deve rabbi chiyyay: medummaot dekodesh.
Umi ikka dimmua lekodesh? amri deve rabbi ilay: bimtaher et tivlo littol mimmennu nesachim.
Kodem laggittot shivim yom. amar abbaye, shema minna: dina hu deillave arisa lemitrach aggulefe shivim yomin mikkamme matzarta.

Mishna min hammodiim velifnim neemanin al kele cheres. min hammodiim velachutz — en neemanin. ketzad? hakkaddar shehu mocher hakkederot, nichnas lifnim min hammodiim, hu hakkaddar vehen hakkederot vehen hallokchin — neeman, yatza — eno neeman.
Gemara tana: modiim — peamim kelifnim, peamim kelachutz. ketzad? kaddar yotze vechaver nichnas — kelifnim. shenehen nichnasin

a: O shenehen yotzin — kelachutz.

Amar abbaye, af anan name tenena: hakkaddar shemmachar et hakkederot venichnas lifnim min hammodiim. tama delifnim min hammodiim, ha modiim gufa — la meheman. ema sefa: yatza — eno neeman. ha modiim gufah — neeman. ella lav shema minna: kan bekaddar yotze vechaver nichnas, kan besheshshenehen yotzin o shenehen nichnasin. shema minna.
Tana: neemanin bichle cheres haddakkin lakkodesh. amar resh lakish: vehu shennittalin beyado achat. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu sheen nittalin beyado achat.

Amar resh lakish: lo shanu ella rekanin, aval melein — lo. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu meleim, vaafillu appikarsuto letocho. veamar rava: umode rabbi yochanan bemashkin atzman, shehen temein. veal titma, shehare lagin male mashkin — lagin temein tumeat shiva, umashkin tehorin.
Mishna haggabbain shennichnesu letoch habbayit, vechen haggannavim shehechziru et hakkelim — neemanin lomar: lo naganu. uvirushalayim neemanin al hakkodesh, uvishat haregel af al hatteruma.

Gemara ureminhi: haggabbain shennichnesu letoch habbayit — habbayit kullo tame. la kashya: ha deikka goy bahadayyhu, ha delekka goy bahadayyhu. ditnan: im yesh goy immahen — neemanin lomar "lo nichnasnu", aval en neemanim lomar "nichnasnu aval lo naganu".
Vechi ikka goy bahadayyhu may have? rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar, chad amar: emat goy alehen. vechad amar: emat malchut alehen. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu goy sheeno chashuv.

Vechen haggannavim shehechziru et hakkelim. ureminhi: haggannavim shennichnesu letoch habbayit — eno tame ella mekom derisat ragle haggannavim. amar rav pinchas mishshemeh derav: kesheasu teshuva. dayka name, dekatane: shehechziru et hakkelim. shema minna.
Uvirushalayim neemanin al hakkodesh. tana: neemanin al kele cheres gassin lakkodesh. vechol kach lamma — sheen osin kivshonot birushalayim.
Uvishat haregel af al hatteruma. menahane mille? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, deamar kera: "vayyeasef kol ish yisrael el hair keish echad chaverim", hakkatuv asaan kullan chaverim.
Mishna happoteach et chavito, vehammatchil beissato al gav haregel, rabbi yehuda omer: yigmor, vachachamim omrim: lo yigmor.
Gemara yatev rabbi amme verabbi yitzchak nappacha akkila derabbi yitzchak nappacha, petach chad vaamar: mahu sheyyannichenna leregel acher?

Amar leh iddach: yad hakkol memashmeshin bah veat amrat yannichenna leregel acher?! amar leh: attu ad haiddana lav yad hakkol memashmeshin bah? amar leh: hachi hasheta?! bishlama ad haiddana, tumeat am haaretz baregel rachamana tahara, ella hasheta temea hi.
Nema ketannae, detane chada: yannichenna leregel acher, vetanya iddach: lo yannichenna leregel acher. may lav tannae hi?

La, ha dekatane yannichenna — rabbi yehuda, veha dekatane lo yannichenna — rabbanan. vetisbera? ha rabbi yehuda, yigmor kaamar?! ella: ha dekatane lo yannichenna — rabbi yehuda, veha dekatane yannichenna — rabbanan. umay lo yannichenna — sheen tzarich lehannichah.
Mishna mishsheavar haregel — maavirin al tohorat haazara. avar haregel leyom shishshi — lo hayu maavirin, mippene kevod hashshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer: af lo beyom chamishi, sheen hakkohanim penuyin.
Gemara tana: sheen hakkohanim penuyin millehotzi baddeshen.
Mishna ketzad maavirin al tohorat azara? matbilin et hakkelim shehayu bammikdash, veomrin lahem: hizzaharu
b: Shello tiggeu bashshulchan.

Kol hakkelim shehayu bammikdash yesh lahem sheniyyim ushelishim, sheim nitmeu harishonim — yaviu sheniyyim tachtehen. kol hakkelim shehayu bammikdash teunin tevila, chutz mimmizbach hazzahav umizbach hannechoshet mippene shehen kakkarka, divre rabbi eliezer, vachachamim omrim: mippene shehen metzuppin.
Gemara tana: hizzaharu shemma tiggeu bashshulechan uvammenora. vetanna didan, may tama la tane menora? shulchan ketiv beh "tamid", menora la ketiv ba "tamid".
Veiddach: kevan dichtiv: "veet hammenora nochach hashshulchan", keman dichtiv ba "tamid" dame. veiddach: hahu likboa lah makom hu daata.
Vetippok li dichli etz heasuy lenachat hu, vechol keli etz heasuy lenachat la metamme. may tama — dumeya desak baenan: ma sak mittaltel male verekam — af kol mittaltel male verekam!
Hay name mittaltel male verekam hu, kidresh lakish. deamar resh lakish: may dichtiv: "al hashshulchan hattahor", mikkelal shehu tame.

Veammay? keli etz heasuy lenachat hu, veeno mekabbel tumea! ella melammed shemmagbihin oto umarin bo leole regalim lechem happanim, veomrim lahem: reu chibbatchem lifne hammakom, silluko kesidduro. deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: nes gadol naasa belechem happanim, kesidduro kach silluko, shenneemar: "lasum lechem chom beyom hillakcho".
Vetippok li mishshum tzippuy. dehatnan: hashshulchan vehaddulepke shennifchatu, o shechippan beshayish, veshiyyer bahem mekom hannachat kosot — tame. rabbi yehuda omer: makom hannachat hachatichot.

Vechi tema: shane atze shittim dachashivi vela batli, hanicha leresh lakish, deamar: lo shanu ella bichle ekkeslagem habbain mimmedinat hayyam, aval bichle mesimem — la batli, shappir. ella lerabbi yochanan, deamar: afillu bichle mesimem name batli, may ikka lememar?
Vechi tema: kan betzippuy omed, kan betzippuy sheeno omed — ha bea minneh resh lakish merabbi yochanan: betzippuy omed, o betzippuy sheeno omed? bechofe et levizbezav, o besheeno chofe et levizbezav?
Vaamar leh: la shena betzippuy omed vela shena betzippuy sheeno omed, la shena bechofe et levizbezav vela shena besheeno chofe et levizbezav. ella: shane shulchan —

a: Derachamana karyeh "etz", dichtiv: "hammizbeach etz shalosh ammot gavoah veorko shetayim ammot umiktzootav lo veorko vekirotav etz vaydabber elay ze hashshulchan asher lifne Adonai".
Patach bemizbeach vesiyyem beshulchan! rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayyhu: bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym — mizbeach mechapper al adam, achshav — shulchano shel adam mechapper alav.
Kol hakkelim shebbammikdash yesh lahem sheniyyim kulei. mizbach hannechoshet, dichtiv: "mizbach adama taase li". mizbach hazzahav, dichtiv: "hammenora vehammizbechot" — ittakkush mizbechot ze laze.
Vachachamim omrim: mippene shehen metzuppin. adderabba: kevan dimtzuppin ninhu — mittammeu! ema, vachachamim: metammein, mippene shehen metzuppin.
Veibbaet ema: rabbanan lerabbi eliezer kaamri: may dataych, mishshum dimtzuppin —
Mivtal batel tzippuyayn gabbayyhu.

Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar: talmide chachamim en ur shel gehinnam sholetet bahen, kal vachomer missalamandera: uma salamandera shettoledet esh hi — hassach middamah en ur sholetet bo, talmide chachamim shekkol gufan esh, dichtiv: "halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai" — al achat kamma vechamma.

Amar resh lakish: en ur shel gehinnam sholetet befoshe yisrael, kal vachomer mimmizbach hazzahav: ma mizbach hazzahav sheen alav ella keovi dinar zahav — kamma shanim en haur sholetet bo, poshe yisrael shemmelein mitzvot kerimmon, dichtiv: "kefelach harimmon rakkatech", al tikre "rakkatech", ella: rekanin shebbach — al achat kamma vechamma.
Hadaran alach chomer bakkodesh uselika la massechet chagiga
Chamesh esre nashim potrot tzarotehen vetzarot tzarotehen min hachalitza umin hayyibbum ad sof haolam.
Veellu hen: bitto, uvat bitto, uvat beno, bat ishto,
Uvat benah, uvat bittah, chamoto, veem chamoto, veem chamiv,
Achoto meimmo, vaachot immo, vaachot ishto, veeshet achiv meimmo,
b: Veeshet achiv shello haya beolamo, vechallato. hare ellu potrot tzarotehen vetzarot tzarotehen min hachalitza umin hayyibbum ad sof haolam.
Vechullan im metu o meanu,
O nitgarshu o shennimtzeu aylonit — tzarotehen muttarot.
Vei atta yachol lomar bachamoto uveem chamoto uveem chamiv shennimtzeu aylonit o shemmeanu.

Ketzad potrot tzarotehen: hayta bitto o achat mikkol haarayot haellu nesuot leachiv, velo ishsha acheret, vamet — keshem shebbitto petura, kach tzaratah petura. halcha tzarat bitto venisset leachiv hashsheni, velo ishsha acheret, vamet — keshem shetztzarat bitto petura, kach tzarat tzaratah petura.
Afillu hen mea.
Ketzad im metu tzarotehen muttarot: hayta bitto o achat mikkol haarayot haellu nesuot leachiv, velo ishsha acheret, meta bitto o nitgarsha, veachar kach met achiv — tzaratah mutteret.
Vechol hayyechola lemaen velo meana — tzaratah choletzet velo mityaybemet.
Gemara mikkedi kullehu meachot ishsha yalfinan, litne achot ishsha beresha!
Vechi tema: tanna chumere chumere naket, verabbi shimon hi, deamar serefa chamura.
I hachi, litne chamoto beresha, deikkar serefa bachamoto ketiva! veod: batar chamoto litne kallato, devatar serefa sekila chamura!
Ella: bitto, kevan deatya midderasha, chabbiva leh.

a: Kullehu name midderasha atu! nehi dilinyan yibbum atyayn midderasha — ikkar issurayyhu behedya ketiv behu. bitto, ikkar issura midderasha.
Deamar rava: amar li rav yitzchak bar avdimi: atya "henna" "henna",
Atya "zimma" "zimma".
Hasheta deamrat kol milleta deatya midderasha chabbiva leh, litne laachot ishsha levassof! ayyeyde deayyri beissur achvota, tena achot ishto.
Velitneyeh lehay bava levassof! ella: tanna kureve kureve naket: tena bitto uvat bitto uvat beno, dikrove atzmo,
Veayyeyde ditna shelosha dorot lematta dideh, tena name shelosha dorot lematta dida. veayyeyde ditna shelosha dorot lematta dida, tena shelosha dorot lemala dida.

Utena achoto vaachot immo dikrove atzmo. veayyeyde deayyri beissur achva, tena achot ishto. uvedin hu delaykdema lechallato mikkamme eshet achiv shello haya beolamo, dela mishshum kureba hu daasira. ella, ayyeyde deayyri beissur achva, tena eshet achiv shello haya beolamo, vahadar tena kallato.
Umay irya ditna "potrot"? litne "osrot"! i tena "osrot", hava amena asur leyaybem, aval michlatz — chaltza, ka mashma lan.
Velitne "asura lachlotz"! may kaaved? allema lo, im atta omer "choletzet", mityaybemet!
Kevan devimkom mitzva hu daasira tzara, veshello bimkom mitzva sharya, mishshum hachi tane "potrot".

Umay irya detane "min hachalitza umin hayyibbum"? litne "min hayyibbum" lechodeh! i tena "min hayyibbum" hava amena michlatz — chaltza, yabbome — la meyaybma, ka mashma lan kol haole leyibbum — ole lachalitza, vechol sheeno ole layyibbum — eno ole lachalitza.
Velitne "min hayyibbum umin hachalitza", i name "min hachalitza" lechoda? abba shaul hi, deamar: mitzvot chalitza kodemet lemitzvot yaybum.
Minyana deresha lemaote may, uminyana desefa lemaote may?
b: Lemaote derav uderav assi. lerav ulerav assi lemaote may?
I sevira lehu dahadade — chada lemaote tzarat memaenet, vachada lemaote tzarat machazir gerushato.
Vei la sevira lehu dahadade — chada lemaote dechavreh, vachada lemaote o tzarat memaenet, o tzarat machazir gerushato.
Lerav ulerav assi, litninhu?
Lefi sheenah betzarat tzara.
Mena hane mille — detanu rabbanan: "ishsha el achotah lo tikkach litzror legallot ervatah aleha bechayyeha". "aleha", ma talmud lomar?
Lefi shenneemar: "yevamah yavo aleha", shomea ani afillu beachat mikkol arayot haamurot battora hakkatuv medabber, neemar kan "aleha" veneemar lehallan "aleha",
Ma lehallan bimkom mitzva, af kan bimkom mitzva, veamar rachamana: "lo tikkach".
Veen li ella hi, tzaratah minnayin? talmud lomar: "litzror". veen li ella tzaratah, tzarat tzaratah minnayin? talmud lomar: "litzror", velo "latzor".

Veen li ella achot ishsha, shear arayot minnayin? amarta: ma achot ishsha meyuchedet — shehi erva, vechayyayvin al zedonah karet veal shiggatah chattat, vaasura layyavam; af kol shehi erva, vechayyayvin al zedonah karet veal shiggatah chattat — asura layyavam.

Veen li ella hen, tzarotehen minnayin? amarta: ma achot ishsha meyuchedet — shehi erva vechayyayvin al zedonah karet veal shiggatah chattat, vaasura layyavam, vetzaratah asura; af kol shehi erva, vechayyayvin al zedonah karet veal shiggatah chattat, vaasura layyavam — tzaratah asura. mikkan amru chachamim: chamesh esre nashim potrot tzarotehen vetzarot tzarotehen min hachalitza umin hayyibbum ad sof haolam.
Yachol sheani merabbe af shesh arayot chamurot meellu, sheyyehu tzarotehem asurot?

Amarta: ma achot ishto meyuchedet shehi erva, vechayyayvin al zedonah karet veal shiggatah chattat, veefshar linnase laachim, vaasura layyavam, vetzaratah asura; af kol shehi erva, vechayyayvin al zedonah karet veal shiggatah chattat, veefshar linnase laachim, vaasura layyavam — tzaratah asura.
Yatzu shesh arayot chamurot meellu, hoil dei efshar linnase laachim — tzarotehen muttarot, sheen tzara ella meach.
Azhara shamanu, onesh minnayin? amar kera: "ki kol (ish) asher yaase mikkol hattoevot vegomer".
Tama dichtav rachamana "aleha", ha lav hachi, hava amena achot ishsha miyyaybma, may tama? deamrinan: ate ase vedache lo taase?!
Emar deamrinan ate ase vedache lo taase — lo taase gereda, lo taase sheyyesh bo karet mi dache? vetu: lo taase gereda menalan dedache —

a: Dichtiv: "lo tilbash shaatnez", "gedilim taase lach".
Veamar rabbi elazar: semuchim min hattora minnayin, shenneemar: "semuchim laad leolam asuyim beemet veyashar".

Veamar rav sheshet amar rabbi elazar mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya: minnayin livama shennafla lifne mukke shechin sheen chosmin otah — shenneemar: "lo tachsom shor bedisho", usemich leh: "ki yeshvu achim yachdav".
Veamar rav yosef: afillu leman dela daresh semuchim bealma, bemishne tora daresh. deha rabbi yehuda bealma la daresh, uvemishne tora daresh.

Uvealma menalan dela daresh? detanya: ben azzay omer, neemar: "mechashshefa lo techayye", veneemar: "kol shochev im behema mot yumat", semacho inyan lo: ma shochev im behema biskila — af mechashshefa biskila.
Amar lo rabbi yehuda: vechi mippene shessemacho inyan lo, notzi ze liskila?
Ella: ov veyiddeoni bichlal mechashshefim hayu, velamma yatzu? lehakkish lahem velomar lach: ma ov veyiddeoni biskila — af mechashshefa biskila.
Uvemishne tora menalan dedaresh? ditnan: nose adam anusat aviv umefuttat aviv, anusat beno umefuttat beno. rabbi yehuda oser baanusat aviv umefuttat aviv.
Veamar rav giddel amar rav: may tama derabbi yehuda, dichtiv: "lo yikkach ish et eshet aviv velo yegalle kenaf aviv", kanaf sheraa aviv — lo yegalle.
Umimmay devaanusa ketiv — meillaveh dikra, dichtiv: "venatan haish hashshochev immah laavi hannaara chamishshim kasef", usemich leh: "lo yikkach ish vegomer".
Verabbanan: i hava semich leh, kidkaamrat. hasheta dela semich leh (dichtiv "lo yikkach ish et eshet aviv" bentayim) —
Beshomeret yavam hakkatuv medabber, velaavor alav bishne lavin.
Uvemishne tora may tama dedaresh? ibbaet ema — mishshum demochach, veibbaet ema — mishshum demufene.

Ibbaet ema mishshum demochach — deim ken lichteveh rachamana gabbe arayot. veibbaet ema mishshum demufene — deim ken lichtov rachamana: "lo yikkach ish et eshet aviv", "lo yegalle kenaf aviv" lema li?
b: Shema minna leafnoye. vegabbe tzitzit name, ibbaet ema — mishshum demochach, veibbaet ema — mishshum demufene.

Ibbaet ema mishshum demochach — deim ken lichteveh rachamana gabbe parashat tzitzit, lemay hilcheta katveh hacha? veibbaet ema mishshum demufene — mikkedi ketav: "uveged kilayim shaatnez lo yaale alecha", "lo tilbash shaatnez" lema li? shema minna leafnoye.

Hane mitzrach tzerichi, dei ketav rachamana "lo yaale alecha", have amena: kol derech haalaa asar rachamana, vaafillu mochre chesut, ketav rachamana "lo tilbash shaatnez", dumeya dilvisha, deit beh hanaa.
Vei ketav rachamana "lo tilbash", hava amena: davka levisha, dinfish hanayayta, aval haalaa — la, ketav rachamana "lo yaale alecha".
Im ken, lichtov rachamana "lo tilbash shaatnez", "tzemer ufishtim" lema li?

Mikkedi ketav "uveged kilayim shaatnez lo yaale alecha", vetana deve rabbi yishmael: hoil veneemru battora setam "begadim", ufarat lecha hakkatuv beechad mehen tzemer ufishtim — af kol tzemer ufishtim, "tzemer ufishtim" dichtav rachamana lema li? shema minna leafnoye.
Veakkatti itzterich, salka datach amena: haalaa hi dela nefish hanaata, aval levisha dinfish hanayayta — kol tere mine asar rachamana, ketav rachamana "tzemer ufishtim"!
Im ken, lishtok kera minneh, vetete "shaatnez" "shaatnez" mehaalaa.
Vetanna deve rabbi yishmael: tama dichtav rachamana "tzemer ufishtim", ha lav hachi, kilayim betzitzit hava amena daasar rachamana? vehachtiv: "veasu lahem tzitzit al kanfe vigdehem",
Vetanna deve rabbi yishmael: kol begadim tzemer ufishtim hem, veamar rachamana aved leh techelet, utechelet amra hu. umimmay ditchelet amra hu? middeshesh — kittana, techelet — amra hu.
Itzterich, salka datach amena kidrava, derava rame: ketiv "hakkanaf" — min kanaf, uchetiv "tzemer ufishtim"!
Ha ketzad? tzemer ufishtim potrin ben beminan, ben shello beminan. shear minin, beminan potrin, shello beminan en potrin.
Veha tanna deve rabbi yishmael let leh derava!

Itzterich, salka datach amena, ki diyyuka derava: "hakkanaf" — min kanaf, vehachi kaamar rachamana: aved leh tzemer letzemer ufishtim lefishtim. vechi avydat tzemer letzemer — tziveh, aval tzemer lefishtim ufishtim letzemer — la, ketav rachamana "tzemer ufishtim", daafillu tzemer lefishtim ufishtim letzemer.

a: Tinach letanna deve rabbi yishmael. lerabbanan, mena lehu?
Nafka lehu merosho". detanya: "rosho" ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar: "lo takkifu (et) peat roshchem", shomea ani af metzora ken,
Talmud lomar: "rosho". veka savar hay tanna hakkafat kol harosh shemah hakkafa.
Ikka lemifrach: ma lelav dehakkafa, shekken lav sheen shave bakkol!
Ella: atya mizzekano". detanya: "zekano" ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar: "ufeat zekanam lo yegallechu", shomea ani af kohen metzora ken — talmud lomar "zekano".
Veim eno inyan lelav sheen shave bakkol, tenehu inyan lelav hashshave bakkol.
Veakkatti itzterich, salka datach amena: shane kohanim, hoil veribba bahen hakkatuv mitzvot yeterot, afillu lav sheen shave bakkol la dache, ka mashma lan dedache!
Ella, atya merosho" dehach tanna. detanya: "rosho", ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar "taar lo yaavor al rosho", shomea ani af metzora venazir ken, talmud lomar: "rosho".
Ikka lemifrach: ma lenazir metzora shekken yeshno bishela. dei la tema hachi — ha dekayyma lan deen ase doche lo taase vaase,
Ligmar minnazir! ella, minnazir may tama la gamrinan, deikka lemifrach shekken yeshno bishela. hachi name ikka lemifrach shekken yeshno bishela.
Ella, leolam
b: Mikkera kamma. im ken, lema kera: "tzitzit taase lach", "gedilim" lema li? shema minna leafnoye.
Hay leshiura hu daata: gedil — "shenayim", "gedilim" — arbaa: ase gedil ufotlehu mittocho!
Im ken, lema kera "lo tilbash shaatnez", "tzemer ufishtim yachdav" lema li? shema minna leafnoye.
Veakkatti mibbee leh: letochef shete techifot — chibbur, utechifa achat — eno chibbur! im ken, lichtov rachamana "lo tilbash tzemer ufishtim yachdav", "shaatnez" lema li? shema minna leafnoye.
Veakkatti mibbee leh, ad sheyyehe shua tavuy, venuz! ella: kulla mishshaatnez" nafka.
Ashkechan deate ase vedache lo taase gereda, lo taase sheyyesh bo karet — hecha ashkechan dedache deitzterich "aleha" lemesra?
Vechi tema nelaf mimmilla: ma lemila, shekken nichretu aleha shelosh esre beritot!
Mippesach: ma lefesach shekken karet!
Mittamid: ma letamid shekken tadir!
Mechada la atya, tete mittarte: mehe tete? mimmila ufesach — shekken karet! mippesach vetamid — shekken tzorech gavoah.
Mimmila vetamid — shekken yeshno lifne haddibbur, veallibba deman deamar ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar — olat tamid hava. umikkullehu name, shekken yeshnan lifne haddibbur!
Ella, itzterich. salka datach amena tete mikkibbud av vaem.
Detanya: yachol yehe kibbud av vaem doche shabbat — talmud lomar: "ish immo veaviv tirau veet shabbetotay tishmoru", kullechem chayyayvin bichvodi.
May lav daamar leh: shechot li, bashshel li, vetama dichtav rachamana "et shabbetotay tishmoru", ha lav hachi — dache? la —

a: Lav dimchammer, vaafillu hachi la dache.
Ella dekayyma lan deate ase vedache lo taase, ligmar mehacha dela lidche!
Vechi tema, shane lave deshabbat dachamiri — veha tanna bealma kae, vela kafarech!
Detanya, yachol amar lo aviv: hittamme, o sheamar lo: al tachzir, yachol yishma lo? talmud lomar: "ish immo veaviv tirau veet shabbetotay tishmoru", kullechem chayyayvin bichvodi.
Ella, mishshum deikka lemifrach:
Ma lehanach shekken hechsher mitzva.

Ella, salka datach amena: tete mibbinyan bet hammikdash. detanya: yachol yehe binyan bet hammikdash doche shabbat — talmud lomar: "et shabbetotay tishmoru umikdashi tirau" — kullechem chayyayvin bichvodi.
May lav, bevone vesoter, vetama dichtav rachamana "et shabbetotay tishmoru", ha lav hachi — dache!
La, lav dimchammer, vaafillu hachi la dache. veella dekayyma lan deate ase vedache lo taase, ligmar mehacha dela dache!

Vechi tema, shane lave deshabbat dachamiri — veha tanna bealma kae, vela ka farech! detanya, yachol amar lo aviv: hittamme, o sheamar lo: al tachzir, yachol yishma lo — talmud lomar: "ish immo veaviv tirau vegomer" — kullechem chayyayvim bichvodi.
Ella, mishshum deikka lemifrach: ma lehanach shekken hechsher mitzva. hechsher mitzva tippok li mehatam?

In hachi name. veet shabbetotay tishmoru umikdashi tirau" lema li? mibbee leh, lechidtanya: yachol yityayre adam mimmikdash, talmud lomar: "et shabbetotay tishmoru veet mikdashi tirau". neemra shemira bashshabbat, veneemra mora bammikdash. ma shemira haamura bashshabbat —
b: Lo mishshabbat atta mityayre, ella mimmi shehizhir al hashshabbat, af mora haamura bammikdash — lo mimmikdash atta mityayre, ella mimmi shehizhir al hammikdash.
Vee zo hi mora mikdash? lo yikkanes adam behar habbayit bemaklo, beminalo, befunedato, uveavak sheal gabbe raglav, velo yaasennu kappandarya. urekika mikkal vachomer.

Veen li ella bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym — minnayin? talmud lomar: "et shabbetotay tishmoru umikdashi tirau". ma shemira haamura beshabbat — leolam, af mora haamura bammikdash — leolam.
Ella, salka datach amena: tete mehaveara. detana deve rabbi yishmael: "lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem", ma talmud lomar?
Ma talmud lomar?! i lerabbi yose — lelav. i lerabbi natan — lechallek.
Detanya: haveara lelav yatzata, divre rabbi yose. rabbi natan omer: lechallek.
Veamar rava: tanna "moshavot" ka kashya leh: "moshavot" ma talmud lomar?
Mikkede shabbat chovat hagguf hi, vechovat hagguf noheget ben baaretz ben bechutz laaretz, "moshavot" dichtav rachamana beshabbat — lema li?

Mishshum rabbi yishmael amar talmid echad, lefi shenneemar: "vechi yihye veish chet mishpat mavet vehumat", shomea ani ben bachol ben bashshabbat. uma ani mekayyem "mechalleleha mot yumat" — bishar melachot, chutz mimmitat bet din. o eno ella afillu mitat bet din, uma ani mekayyem "vehumat" — bachol velo bashshabbat.
O eno ella afillu bashshabbat, talmud lomar: "lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem", ulehallan hu omer: "vehayu elle lachem lechukkat mishpat ledorotechem bechol moshvotechem",
Ma moshavot haamurim lehallan — bevet din, af moshavot haamurim kan — bevet din, veamar rachamana: "lo tevaaru".
May lav: rabbi natan hi, deamar: lechallek yatzata. vetama dichtav rachamana "lo tevaaru", ha lav hachi — dache?
La, rabbi yose. vetihve name rabbi yose, emar deamar rabbi yose: haveara lelav yatzata — haveara geredta,
