Haveara devet din — bishshul petila hu!
Veamar rav sheshet: ma li bishshul petila, ma li bishshul sammanin.

Amar rav shimi bar ashe: hay tanna la mishshum deate ase vedache lo taase, ella mishshum demayyte mikkal vachomer. vehachi kaamar: ma ani mekayyem "mechalleleha mot yumat" — bishar melachot, chutz mimmitat bet din. aval mitat bet din — dachaya shabbat mikkal vachomer,

a: Uma avoda, shehi chamura vedocha shabbat — retzicha docha otah, shenneemar: "meim mizbechi tikkachennu lamut", shabbat, shennidchet mippene avoda — eno din shettehe retzicha docha otah?

Umay "o eno" dekaamar — hachi kaamar: kevurat met mitzva tochiach, sheddocha et haavoda, veen docha et hashshabbat. hadar amar: kevurat met mitzva tidche shabbat mikkal vachomer: uma avoda shehi docha shabbat — kevurat met mitzva docha otah,
Miuleachoto", shabbat shennidchet mippene avoda — eno din shettehe kevurat met mitzva docha otah? talmud lomar: "lo tevaaru".
Ulemay dislek addateh meikkara deate ase vedache lo taase, may "o eno" dekaamar?
Hachi kaamar: ma ani mekayyem "mechalleleha mot yumat" — bishar melachot chutz mimmitat bet din. aval mitat bet din dache shabbat, deate ase vedache lo taase.

Hadar amar: emar deamrinan deate ase vedache lo taase — lo taase gereda, lo taase sheyyesh bo karet mi shamat leh dedache? hadar amar: attu "ase doche et lo taase", lav lo taase chamur minneh, vekaate ase vedache leh?
Ma li chumera zuta uma li chumera rabba, talmud lomar: "lo tevaaru".
Ella [itzterich], salka datach amena: tihve hay eshet ach davar shehaya bakkelal veyatza min hakkelal lelammed — lo lelammed al atzmo yatza, ella lelammed al hakkelal kullo yatza.
Detanya: davar shehaya bakkelal veyatza min hakkelal vechulei, ketzad?

"Vehannefesh asher tochal basar mizzevach hashshelamim vetumeato alav", vahalo shelamim bichlal kodashim hayu, velamma yatzu — lehakkish alehen, velomar lach: ma shelamim meyuchadim kodshe mizbeach — af kol kodshe mizbeach. yatzu kodshe bedek habbayit.
Hacha name: ha eshet ach bichlal kol haarayot hayta, velamma yatzta — lehakkish eleha, velomar lach: ma eshet ach sharya — af kol arayot name sharyayn.
Mi dame? hatam: kelal beissur, uferat beissur. hacha: kelal beissur, uferat behetter.

Ha la dame ella ledavar shehaya bakkelal, veyatza liddon bedavar hechadash — shei atta yachol lehachaziro lichlalo, ad sheyyachzirennu lecha hakkatuv beferush. detanya: davar shehaya bakkelal, veyatza liddon bedavar hechadash — i atta rashshay lehacheziro lichlalo, ad sheyyachzirennu lecha hakkatuv beferush.

Ketzad? "veshachat et hakkeves bimkom asher yishchat et hachattat veet haola bimkom hakkodesh ki kachattat haasham hu lakkohen", sheen talmud lomar: "kachattat haasham", uma talmud lomar: "kachattat haasham"?
Lefi sheyyatza asham metzora liddon bedavar hechadash, bevohen yad uvohen regel hayemanit. yachol lo yehe taun mattan damim veemurim legabbe mizbeach —
b: Talmud lomar: "ki kachattat haasham hu". ma chattat teuna mattan damim veemurim legabbe mizbeach — af asham taun mattan damim veemurim legabbe mizbeach.
Vei la ahdereh kera — hava amena: lemay dinfak — nefak, ulemay dela nefak — la nefak. hacha name, hava amena: eshet ach deishtera[10] — ishteray, shear arayot — la.
Ella, salka datach amena: tete bema matzinu" meeshet ach. ma eshet ach miyyaybma — af achot ishsha tityaybem.
Mi dame? hatam chad issura — hacha tere issure! mahu detema: hoil veishteri — ishteri.

Umena temra deamrinan hoil veishteri ishteri — detanya: metzora shechal shemini shello baerev happesach, veraa keri bo bayyom, vetaval, amru chachamim: af al pi sheen tevul yom acher nichnas, ze — nichnas.
Mutav sheyyavo ase sheyyesh bo karet veyidche ase sheen bo karet. veamar rabbi yochanan: devar tora afillu ase let beh,

Shenneemar: "vayyaamod yehoshafat bikhal yehuda lifne hechatzer hachadasha". may "chatzer hachadasha"? amar (rabbi yochanan): shechiddeshu bah devarim, veamru: tevul yom lo yikkanes lemachane leviyya.
Veamar ulla: ma taam? hoil vehuttar letzarato — huttar lekirvyo. mi dame lidulla?
